body.prose: No worries, thank you. Can do nesting of bullet points. There's nothing wrong with that. You might use it to substitute a real brief structure before you build it, etc. That's probably okay. But there is another side of this where we are not covering everything we need to reflect on. The first thing is that this is all then within one body. Now, is that the right thing? When do we need to break a [holon] into multiple [holons]? Should it in fact be that each of these are [holons], but we now can create virtual spaces for [holons]? Like nested universes that you don't clutter your unless you care for. What about the fact that language breaks into not only paragraphs but sentences and to words? What about being able then to give things more meaning I can see here that words can be replaced by having a key as an object. For bolding, etc. All of this is just reserved strings. Whilst if it were [holons] and types, it'd be different, right? And once I was considering that, you know, for you be able to mark a word and add a comment on a word, that word needs to be addressable. And unless you actually break a paragraph into its sentences and into its words, that is not particularly possible. The same way so I'm not sure yet about this. It opens up for various questions
body.title: Into how many holons does prose break
